verdict.rationale: A probe confirms NVIDIA's developer portal serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200), which covers the CUDA toolkit and SDK ecosystem used to program this GPU, so an agent has an entry point. That llms.txt is portal-wide rather than specific to the RTX 5070 Ti, and the markdown docs variant (cuda-toolkit.md) returns 404. Missing for 10: product-specific agent-oriented docs, per-page markdown docs, and independent or hands-on evidence that agents can use the llms.txt effectively.
